q: The practice of cultivating the soil, growing crops, and raising animals is called ____. (P1)
explain: Agriculture provides food, clothing materials, and raw industrial products for human society.
hint: Cultivation of soil and raising livestock.

q: Which of these is a cereal food crop grown on farms? (P1)
explain: Maize is a staple cereal grain providing energy-giving carbohydrates for humans and livestock.

q: Which of these is a common farm animal raised for milk and beef? (P1)
explain: Cattle provide dairy milk, nutritious beef, and leather hides for industry.

q: Which farm tool has a curved metal blade with a wooden handle used for cutting bush and harvesting? (P1)
explain: Cutlasses are essential manual hand tools for clearing thick brush and harvesting mature crops.

q: Which simple farm tool is used for making heaps, ridges, and weeding soil? (P1)
explain: Hoes are traditional digging and weeding implements in tropical agriculture.
hint: Digging tool with a flat metal blade.

q: Crop classification: Yam is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Yam is botanically classified as a tuber / root crop.

q: Crop classification: Cassava is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Cassava is botanically classified as a tuber / root crop.

q: Crop classification: Rice is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Rice is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Millet is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Millet is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Sorghum (Guinea corn) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Sorghum (Guinea corn) is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Cowpea (Beans) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Cowpea (Beans) is botanically classified as a legume.

q: Crop classification: Groundnut (Peanut) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Groundnut (Peanut) is botanically classified as a legume and oil crop.

q: Crop classification: Oil Palm is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Oil Palm is botanically classified as a oil and cash crop.

q: Crop classification: Cotton is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
options: fibre crop used for making textile clothing
explain: Cotton is botanically classified as a fibre crop used for making textile clothing.

q: Crop classification: Coffee is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Coffee is botanically classified as a beverage crop.

q: Crop classification: Tea is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Tea is botanically classified as a beverage crop.

q: Crop classification: Sugarcane is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 1).
explain: Sugarcane is botanically classified as a sugar crop.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Sheep? [P1]
explain: Sheep provide wool and mutton for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Bees (Apiculture)? [P1]
explain: Bees (Apiculture) provide honey and beeswax for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Silkworm? [P1]
explain: Silkworm provide silk fibre for textiles for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Pigs (Swine)? [P1]
explain: Pigs (Swine) provide pork and bacon for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Goats? [P1]
explain: Goats provide chevon meat, milk, and leather for human consumption and industrial use.
